title: Comparative Analysis of Diffraction Techniques in SEM for Advanced Materials Characterization Based on Direct Electron Detection
content: Direct electron detectors [1] significantly enhance electron microscopes by directly measuring incoming electrons, which improves image resolution and sensitivity. Unlike traditional detectors that convert electrons to light or other signals, direct detection captures more detailed information, reducing noise and increasing signal-to-noise ratio. This capability is crucial for observing fine structural details of specimens in materials science field. Additionally, direct detection allows for data acquisition at lower electron doses, preserving sample integrity. These advancements enable researchers to achieve clearer, more accurate results, facilitating breakthroughs in various scientific fields.
